title: The Bear and the Pear
lines: A brown bear sat by a pear tree.
The best pears were up in the air.
He got a chair, but it had a tear.
It fell, and the bear fell with it.
The bear sat down with a sad face.
Then the wind sent one pear down.
It fell by his paw. He ate it.

questions.ask: Why did the bear get a chair?
questions.listenFor: To get up to the pears, which were high in the air. The answer is in the second and third lines.

questions.ask: How did the bear get a pear in the end?
questions.listenFor: The wind sent one down. Point out that pear, bear, and tear all end the same way and rhyme.

questions.ask: Do you think the bear will try the chair again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason, not the right answer.
